title: Chapter 286: Eliminating The Undead
content:
Chapter 286: Eliminating The Undead

Wang Shuo howled, but couldn't find anyone to vent his anger on.

Just when the Demon Wolf King was hit by countless spears, Takker wisely stopped.

When the Demon Wolf King was blown up, he wisely fled, and took the remaining skeleton soldiers with him.

Wang Shuo could only yell helplessly.

There was another altar in front, and Wang Shuo immediately led his men to destroy it.

After these two battles, Wang Shuo's Red Flame Army can be said to have been tested in actual combat, and the average level has increased by about 3 levels.

The experience of large-scale group battles has continued to increase, and the command values of officers at all levels under his command have also increased to varying degrees, and the comprehensive combat power has once again reached a new level.

After returning to Wana Town, Wang Shuo held a military meeting.

The two battles were summarized.

Faced with a large number of requests for help, Wang Shuo could not ignore them.

There are so many people asking for help at present, and Wang Shuo is also planning to destroy a few more altars, and saving people should be a matter of course.

Wang Shuo briefly introduced the basic situation.

All the soldiers offered suggestions and finally, they decided to destroy the altar of the dead near Nanshanji first, so as to make Wana Town safer.

Wang Shuo told all the members of Nanshan Club that Nanshanji had been temporarily freed from danger, and if they could not resist, they could go there for refuge.

"The leader is mighty, and he has wiped out the dead so quickly."

"Master, there are a large number of people in my territory who have been infected with the dead air. May I ask if there are any dead spirit beads?"

"Hey! I really sympathize with you. Before the resurrection of the dead, I bought a large number of dead spirit beads and bronze bricks. Now there is no way to deal with the army of dead outside the city. It is right to follow the leader!"

"Master, can you come to save me? I feel that I am not the material to be a lord. Please pity the more than 5,000 people in my territory!"

The lord of Gaotang Village spoke sincerely, and Wang Shuo also had the same intention.

So he gathered his troops and began to sweep the surrounding Burning Legion.

During the clearing process, many rescued people expressed their willingness to join Wana Town.

In just two days, the number of people in Wana Town exceeded 50,000.

The population conditions for upgrading to a second-level town have been met, and the public sentiment is still slightly low, but it is only a matter of time to recover.

Now there is only one silver energy converter left, and there is no clue.

The clearing work was carried out in an orderly manner. When dealing with some lower-level skeleton soldiers, Wang Shuo always sent the city defense army to improve their actual combat capabilities.

On this day, Wang Shuo led the Hell Knights to destroy the altar near Mulberry Village. Mulberry Village had been breached by the Burning Legion. The entire village was already a rubble, and no one inside escaped.

After the battle, Wang Shuo took the Hell Knights to rest on the spot, and let the hellhounds enter the breeding space by the way, so that they could quickly recover their physical strength.

Suddenly, a team of fast horses approached from afar and approached rapidly.

Wang Shuo told his men to prepare for battle.

After a while, he saw the person coming, it was Ye Tianba.

He was in a very bad state at this time, his armor was tattered, and there were only 3 people left under his command, which was very miserable.

"Brother Tianba?"

Seeing Wang Shuo, Ye Tianba's hope of life ignited in his heart, but it was extinguished in an instant.

"Go! There are undead knights behind."

After Tianba Town was breached, he could only flee with his men.

But he was chased by the undead knights. In order not to give up any of his men, they fought and retreated, but their numbers continued to decrease.

Someone proposed to cover the rear, but he rejected it.

At this time, he regretted it. If he hadn't insisted on his own way, at least many brothers could have escaped.
